vagas.title: Promo writer (brasil)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

Confira a vaga para Médico (a) - relacionamento médico em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

A Sul América há mais de 130 anos se dedica a entregar Saúde Integral para mais de 7 milhões de clientes por meio de produtos e serviços de Saúde, Odonto, Vida, Previdência e Investimentos. Temos como missão melhorar a vida das pessoas, oferecendo apoio, segurança e autonomia em cada momento e decisão de saúde física, emocional e financeira. Para isso, contamos com mais de 4 mil colaboradores(as) engajados(as) e comprometidos(as). Acreditamos que por meio da inclusão e da diversidade construímos um ambiente seguro e de pertencimento que valoriza e respeita as pessoas integralmente. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência, de diferentes raças e etnias, gêneros, orientações sexuais, identidades de gênero e gerações para todas as nossas vagas.Estamos com oportunidade, para profissionais Médicos (as) que queiram integrar a equipe de relacionamento médico na Sul América.Oportunidade para atuar no time de Relacionamento Médico com as seguintes responsabilidades: Atuar na área de relacionamento médico, realizando atendimento aos médicos das empresas e consultorias clientes da operadora apoiando na interlocução com as áreas internas da companhia como regulação, auditoria, prestadores analisando e propondo ações para o apoio aos segurados do contrato. Atuando ainda com análise dos casos em processo de autorização, priorizando as liberações quando pertinentes. Seguindo com elaboração de comitês técnicos de casos clínicos e de internação domiciliar. Realizando análise de risco em saúde e elaboração de estratégias de gerenciamento de saúde. Participando da elaboração e apresentação de comitês de saúde com análise financeira, demográfica e de riscos em saúde dos contratos, propondo ações para gestão de custos e dos riscos à saúde identificados. Garantindo a excelência do cuidado e sustentabilidade financeira do contrato, tendo uma abrangência em São Paulo - SP, podendo ter visitas presenciais nos clientes.O que esperamos de conhecimentos para essa vaga? Graduação em Medicina, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM). Residência em alguma especialidade médica, por exemplo: ortopedia, coluna, neuro, vascular, cardiologia etc; Conhecimento das normas e regulamentações do setor de saúde (ANS, Código de Ética Médica, etc.); Domínio da terminologia médica e das melhores práticas clínicas; Habilidade de interpretação de exames complementares e laudos médicos; Conhecimento de informática (pacote Office, sistemas de gestão em saúde). Disponibilidade para visitas externas, quando necessário.Diferencial: Pós-graduação ou especialização em Auditoria Médica, Gestão em Saúde ou áreas afins; Experiência em análise de prontuários, auditoria médica ou áreas relacionadas.Outras informações: Modalidade de contrato: PJ Carga horária: 40h semanais, sendo 8hs por dia de segunda a sexta em São Paulo - SP

You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.Key Responsibilities: 1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations: Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., Quick Books Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize). Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Trackintercompany transactions(capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office). 2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR): Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable. Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese. 3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements: Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors. Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports. Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure). 4. Data Integrity & Reporting: Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership. Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory):3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices. Language Fluency:Flawless written and spokenEnglish(for US vendors/clients) andPortuguese(for local operations, banks, and agencies). Technical Proficiency:Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (Quick Books, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets. Job Responsibilities 1. Procurement Execution & Channel Management Source, inquire, compare and negotiate prices for corn, wheat, sorghum, soybeans, soybean meal and other products originating from Brazil and surrounding regions, and complete the full procurement process. Develop and maintain partnerships with local suppliers including farms, traders and ABCD companies, build stable supply channels, and conduct supplier access, evaluation and hierarchical management. 2. Market Analysis & Cost Control Monitor weather conditions, crop planting, local policies, exchange rates, logistics as well as spot and futures prices in Brazilian producing areas, and deliver weekly and monthly market analysis reports plus procurement strategy proposals. Optimize procurement costs under the premise of guaranteed quality and delivery schedule, and manage price fixing, basis and logistics expenses. 3. End-to-End Contract & Order Management Lead business negotiations, draft and review contracts, clarifying terms regarding quality, quantity, pricing, delivery, payment, inspection and claims. Track the whole process including order preparation, loading, customs declaration, document delivery and cargo arrival to ensure smooth performance, and handle abnormalities such as cargo damage, weight shortage and quality disputes. 4. Quality & Origin Control Cooperate with internal and third-party inspection institutions to conduct on-site sampling, testing and loading supervision, ensuring all products comply with China's import standards and internal company regulations. Keep track of quality differences across major Brazilian producing areas, and rationally arrange procurement regions and schedules. 5. Logistics & Warehousing Coordination Liaise with inland transporters, port warehouses, shipping agents and freight forwarders in Brazil to optimize cargo consolidation and sea transportation plans for better efficiency and lower costs. Collaborate with domestic teams of supply chain, finance, risk control and business departments for information synchronization, account reconciliation, settlement and document filing. 6. Compliance & Risk Management Abide by local labor, tax and trade laws and regulations in Brazil, as well as China's import quarantine and customs rules. Identify and prevent risks related to trade, exchange rate, compliance and contract performance. Keep complete business files to ensure full traceability and auditability. 7. Cross-regional Collaboration & Reporting Submit procurement ledgers, cost analysis, supplier reports, weekly and monthly market reports as required. Support domestic business planning and sales demands to maintain stable and sustainable supply.Job Requirements 1. Education & Major Bachelor’s degree or above. Majors in International Trade, Logistics & Supply Chain, Agricultural Economics, Economics or related fields are preferred. 2. Work Experience At least 7 years of working experience in agricultural product procurement. Prior working experience in Brazil or practical experience with grain and oilseed businesses in South America is required. Candidates familiar with the industrial chains of corn, wheat, sorghum, soybeans and soybean meal are preferred. 3. Language Proficiency Fluent in Portuguese and English, capable of conducting business negotiations and reading & drafting contracts proficiently. Proficiency in Chinese is a plus. 4. Professional Competencies Well-versed in the full procurement workflow of bulk agricultural commodities, with solid knowledge of trade terms, contract clauses, quality inspection standards, port logistics and import compliance. Possess strong capabilities in market trend analysis, cost accounting, risk management and business negotiation. Proficient in Excel, ERP and procurement systems, and able to independently complete data analysis and report preparation. 5. Qualifications & Resources Hold valid legal working documents for Brazil. Existing supplier resources and connections with local farms and traders in Brazil are preferred. Relevant certificates for bulk commodity business or rich cross-border trade experience are an advantage. 6. Personal Qualities Willing to reside in Brazil on a long-term basis and accept frequent business trips and field work in producing areas. Able to work under pressure, with a rigorous, meticulous and principled work attitude. Possess excellent cross-cultural communication skills, team spirit and problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with Chinese culture is preferred.Descrição das Responsabilidades do Cargo 1. Execução de compras e gestão de canais de abastecimento: Responsável pela prospecção de fontes, consulta de preços, comparação de cotações, negociação de valores e efetivação das compras de milho, trigo, sorgo, soja, farelo de soja e outras commodities produzidas no Brasil e regiões adjacentes. Desenvolver e manter parcerias com fornecedores locais, como fazendas, comerciantes de grãos e empresas multinacionais do ramo ABCD; estabelecer canais de suprimento estáveis e executar os processos de admissão, avaliação e classificação hierárquica dos fornecedores. 2. Análise de mercado e controle de custos: Acompanhar as condições climáticas, plantio, políticas governamentais, taxa de câmbio, logística e preços de contratos futuros e físicos nas regiões produtoras brasileiras, elaborar relatórios semanais e mensais de análise de mercado e propor estratégias de compras. Otimizar continuamente os custos de aquisição dentro dos padrões de qualidade e prazos de entrega, controlando os preços fixados, os spreads de base e os custos logísticos. 3. Gestão completa de contratos e pedidos: Conduzir negociações comerciais, elaborar e revisar contratos, definindo claramente cláusulas de qualidade, quantidade, preço, entrega, pagamento, inspeção de qualidade e indenizações por perdas. Acompanhar todo o fluxo dos pedidos, incluindo preparo de estoque, carregamento de navios, desembaraço aduaneiro, emissão de documentos e chegada da mercadoria ao porto de destino, garantindo o cumprimento contratual. Tratar incidentes como danificação da carga, falta de peso e contestações de qualidade. 4. Controle de qualidade e origem dos produtos: Colaborar com instituições de inspeção ou terceiros independentes para realizar amostragens, análises laboratoriais e supervisão do carregamento na origem, assegurando que os produtos atendam às normas de importação chinesas e aos controles internos da empresa. Conhecer as diferenças de qualidade entre as principais regiões produtoras do Brasil e planejar racionalmente as áreas de origem dos suprimentos e o ritmo das compras. 5. Coordenação de logística e armazenagem: Interagir com empresas de transporte terrestre interno do Brasil, depósitos portuários, agentes marítimos e despachantes aduaneiros, otimizar os planos de transporte até o porto e transporte marítimo, garantindo o melhor equilíbrio entre prazo logístico e custo. Colaborar com os departamentos nacionais de cadeia de suprimentos, finanças, gestão de riscos e operações comerciais para compartilhar informações, realizar conciliações de contas, efetuar pagamentos e arquivar documentos. 6. Gestão de conformidade e prevenção de riscos: Cumprir as leis trabalhistas, tributárias e comerciais brasileiras, além das normas de quarentena aduaneira e alfândega da China. Identificar e mitigar riscos comerciais, cambiais, de conformidade e de descumprimento contratual. Arquivar todo o conjunto de documentos operacionais para garantir rastreabilidade e auditoria completa. 7. Coordenação inter-regional e elaboração de relatórios: Apresentar regularmente planilhas de controle de compras, análises de custos, relatórios de fornecedores e relatórios semanais/mensais de mercado conforme exigido. Apoiar o planejamento comercial nacional e as demandas da equipe de vendas, garantindo suprimento contínuo e continuidade das operações.

vagas.title: Promo writer (brasil)
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em porto alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

Fundada em 2007 e presente no Brasil desde 2013, a companhia atua atualmente em mais de 15 países, apoiando empresas em sua jornada de descarbonização rentável e sustentável. Seu modelo de negócios é baseado no conceito de Energy as a Service (Eaa S), no qual a Green Yellow investe integralmente, desenvolve, constrói, opera e mantém soluções energéticas de longo prazo, permitindo que seus clientes reduzam custos, emissões e riscos operacionais sem necessidade de investimento próprio (CAPEX zero). Em energia solar fotovoltaica, ultrapassa 930 MWp globalmente. No Brasil, e empresa já construiu mais de 250 MWp em usinas fotovoltaicas, além de um pipeline crescente de projetos instalados junto à carga (behind-the-meter), que integram geração solar, armazenamento em baterias (BESS), eficiência energética e gestão de energia, sobretudo para clientes comerciais e industriais (C&I). A Green Yellow posiciona-se como um player integrado de infraestrutura energética, combinando solução técnica, engenharia financeira, inteligência de dados e gestão contínua de ativos, com investimentos de longo prazo e foco na criação de valor sustentável para seus clientes. vagas.title: Ai operations
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Ai operations em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Liora Liora is an energy fintech: we operate distributed generation assets across Brazil and turn the savings they generate on clients' electricity bills into financial products, credit, cashback and benefits, without increasing what clients pay. Most people treat their electricity bill as a fixed, unavoidable cost, something you pay and forget. What they don't realize is that energy has all the characteristics of a financial asset: it's recurring, predictable, and present in virtually every household and business budget. Liora was built on that insight. The electricity bill stops being a burden and becomes a channel for economic opportunity, especially for the small businesses that traditional finance has always underserved. We're building an AI-first operation where agents score credit & risk, approve or decline applications, and run ownership transfers across dozens of energy distributors. This is not an automation project. It is a real business operation with real clients, real volume and real consequences, designed from day one to be run by AI agents. We are looking for the person who will make it work. What you'll operate Credit & Risk Deciding who is a good payer, who is too risky, and under what terms we should accept each client. Define and apply credit & risk criteria: evaluate payment behavior, energy consumption and other signals to determine approval, limits and risk. Run and improve the operation:m onitor decisions, portfolio health, default rates and edge cases, turning learnings into better rules and processes. Own the AI agents: define how they analyze applications, what they handle autonomously and where they escalate to you. Ownership Transfer Getting every new consumer unit (UC) fully switched over to Liora across dozens of distributors with different rules and systems. Own the process: map distributor requirements and ensure contracts and documentation are correct. Run and unblock the operation: track transfers, resolve rejections and exceptions, and keep applications moving. Own the AI agents: automate execution, define escalation points and continuously expand what agents can handle. These are complex, high-volume operations that, in the traditional model, would require large teams. At Liora, we want them run by agents, with you in command. Who you are We care less about titles and years of experience than about how you think, learn and solve problems. You don't need to have done this before. Very few people have. We're looking for someone early enough in their career to be excited by building something from scratch, but ambitious enough to take real ownership from day one. Degree and industry background don't matter. What matters is that you can move between business judgment and technical execution: understand the problem, build the solution, measure the result and improve it. You're not waiting for a defined process or formal training to get started. You enjoy figuring things out when there is no obvious answer. You spend time experimenting with AI agents because you're genuinely curious. You've tested tools, broken things, understood why they broke and tried again. Why now, why Liora The energy sector is full of opaque tariffs, fragmented processes and decades of accumulated complexity. Liora is turning that complexity into financial infrastructure for SMBs and high-consumption consumers. We're backed by Canary, 17 Sigma and 468 Capital. We doubled in size in the first two months of 2026 and project 15x growth by year end. You'll join while the category is being created, with the autonomy to build the playbook as you go. The window is open. It won't stay that way forever.

Confira a vaga para Senior fpga developer em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.Responsibilities :The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.Qualifications :BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.Required Skills :Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

vagas.title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em porto alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About UsPocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.Role OverviewAs a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.Key Responsibilities1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately80 hours of audio contentwithin defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue deliveryPerform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in EnglishThis role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.

vagas.title: Promo writer (brasil)
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em curitiba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer Location: Remote Position Type: Contract Company: Pocket FM About Us At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series. Role Overview As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution. The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance. You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.Key Responsibilities1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further. They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

Implementação de framework de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) modularizado e gerenciado por agentes de IA; Construção de pipelines CI/CD multi-cloud com deploy Blue/Green e integração de agentes de IA na esteira; Codificação de políticas de segurança e conformidade via Policy-as-Code e integração de ferramentas Dev Sec Ops; Treinamento de modelos de Machine Learning para detecção de ameaças e escalonamento preditivo (Fin Ops); Implantação de agentes autônomos de Auto-healing, AIOps e dashboard inteligente de segurança e custos; Transferência de tecnologia, documentação da plataforma e elaboração do relatório técnico final.Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos Arquitetura e operação em ambientes multi-cloud (AWS, GCP e/ou OCI); Infraestrutura como Código — Ia C (Terraform ou equivalente); Pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Argo CD ou similares); Conteinerização e orquestração (Docker e Kubernetes); Segurança em nuvem: IAM, gestão de vulnerabilidades e conformidade; Machine Learning aplicado: treinamento, validação e implantação de modelos.Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Agentic AI / LLM Ops — agentes de IA para automação de workflows; AIOps — detecção de anomalias e monitoramento inteligente; Fin Ops — otimização de custos em nuvem e Predictive Autoscaling; Policy-as-Code (Open Policy Agent, Sentinel ou similares); Arquiteturas de auto-healing e failover automatizado multi-cloud; Publicações acadêmicas em Dev Sec Ops, MLOps ou infraestrutura autônoma.Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor EmpresarialFormato de trabalho : Remoto / Curitiba/PRSoft Skills : Autogestão, Autonomia, Organização, Trabalho em equipe e Criatividade.

vagas.title: Senior ai agent engineer
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Senior ai agent engineer em curitiba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About First IgniteFirst Ignite makes software for university tech transfer offices. Those are the people who take research coming out of a university lab and get it patented, licensed, or spun out into a company.The role We're hiring a Senior AI Agent Engineer. You'll build the agents in our product, and you'll build the evals that tell us whether each change made them better or worse. The work is document-heavy rather than chat. The agents run multi-step, call tools, read long and inconsistently formatted source material, check it against existing records, and produce output that a person reviews before anything happens with it. Accuracy matters more here than speed or novelty. Most of the engineering effort goes into precision, traceability, and getting the agent to hand off to a human at the right moment. You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work with product and the full-stack team. If you've shipped agents before, you've probably had the experience of changing a prompt and having no idea whether you improved anything. That problem is most of this job.What you'll do • Design and ship long-running, multi-step, tool-using agents on various AI SDKs and tooling, included but not limited to the Open AI Agents SDK, the Anthropic Agent SDK, the Vercel AI SDK, Lang Graph, MCP, and Temporal Cloud. • Wrap our APIs and our partners' APIs as tools an agent can call over MCP. Some of those systems are old, single-tenant, and outside our control, so a fair amount of the work is translation. • Get structured data out of long documents and match it against records that already exist. Expect entity resolution and fuzzy matching, and expect much of it to run in batch. • Stand up eval suites using various evaluation frameworks and tooling, included but not limited to Promptfoo, Braintrust, Lang Smith, Deep Eval, LLM-as-judge methods, and custom harnesses. Measure tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and whether the agent finished the task. • Every agent here produces a draft that a person signs off on. Build the citations and confidence signals that make that review fast, and give the agent a clear way to escalate. • Sit with product and domain experts and turn vague quality goals into something measurable. Sometimes the only dataset available for that is tiny, or confidential, or both. • Instrument production traffic, turn real customer interactions into golden datasets, and run them as regression tests. • Compare models against each other (Open AI, Anthropic, open-weight), along with prompt strategies and agent designs, and know what each option costs in latency and quality. • Bootstrap quality signal for features that have no production traffic yet. That usually means generating synthetic documents and test cases, including the ugly edge cases real customers will eventually send us, and knowing where synthetic data stops being a good proxy. • Write the templates, docs, and tooling the rest of the team needs to run evals without coming to you.Required Qualifications: • 3+ years of engineering experience, including hands-on work on LLM or agent systems that real users touched. • You've evaluated agents, not only models, and you know why single-turn accuracy says little about a multi-step run. • You've integrated against APIs you don't own, including old ones with bad documentation, and turned them into something an agent can call reliably. • You're comfortable with document pipelines: pulling data out, normalizing it, and checking it against a structured source of truth. • You've used at least one LLM evaluation framework, in-house tooling included. • You know how LLM-as-judge methods break down (position bias, verbosity bias, judge drift) and what to do about it. • You can tell a real regression from noise, and design an experiment that answers the question being asked instead of a nearby one. • You can read a customer call transcript, work out which failures matter, and ship a fix and an eval for them. • You write clearly. Engineers won't act on eval results they don't read or don't trust. • You're based somewhere between New York time (ET) and Western European time. Italy is the furthest east we can go. You might currently be titled AI Agent Engineer · Agentic AI Engineer · Senior AI Engineer · AI Systems Engineer · Lead AI Developer · AI Solutions Architect · AI Integration Specialist · Senior Data Scientist, AI Titles are all over the place in this space. If the work above matches what you already do, apply. We'll go on what you've shipped.Preferred Qualifications: • You've evaluated retrieval systems: RAG, hybrid search, reranking. • You've worked with agent orchestration frameworks like Temporal, Lang Graph, or the Open AI Agents SDK, and you know how long-running tool use goes wrong. • You have a background in information retrieval or search relevance. • You've worked somewhere an agent's output carried financial or compliance consequences. • You've built internal tooling that non-engineers used on their own to label and review model output.

A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.    O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.    Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.      Sobre a Oportunidade:      A Vidya é uma empresa de tecnologia aplicada à engenharia industrial, com atuação no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais para apoiar operações complexas, gestão de ativos, eficiência operacional e tomada de decisão em ambientes industriais. Em um cenário de evolução tecnológica e busca por maior produtividade, a empresa fortalece sua jornada de transformação digital com foco em processos mais inteligentes, confiáveis e orientados por dados.    O projeto tem como foco o desenvolvimento e a implementação de uma metodologia integrada para mapeamento, reestruturação e automação de processos operacionais, utilizando Inteligência Artificial, análise de dados, modelagem de processos e machine learning. A iniciativa busca aumentar a confiabilidade das informações, reduzir custos operacionais, otimizar fluxos internos e apoiar decisões estratégicas com base em dados mais consistentes e acessíveis.    Se você tem doutorado em Engenharia de Produção, Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas, e interesse em atuar com transformação digital, BPM, análise estatística e automação de processos organizacionais, essa oportunidade é para você. Buscamos um perfil técnico, analítico e inovador, com visão sistêmica para transformar desafios operacionais em soluções digitais eficientes, escaláveis e de alto impacto.        Formação Acadêmica:    Doutorado completo em Engenharia de Produção, Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.    Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.      Projeto: Transformação Digital de Processos Operacionais com IA para Eficiência e Tomada de Decisão. Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais Experiência prévia em projetos de inovação aplicada no setor industrial, com capacidade de atuar na identificação de gargalos operacionais, estruturação de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e implementação de soluções que promovam ganho de eficiência, redução de custos e melhoria na tomada de decisão baseada em dados.    Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial      Formato de trabalho : Remoto/ Curitiba/PR      Soft Skills : Autogestão, Pensamento Crítico, Organização.

Strong understanding of AI application concepts, including agents and agentic workflows; skills, tools, and function calling; Model Context Protocol; prompt and context design; retrieval-augmented generation; enterprise search and data connectors; grounding, citations, memory, and context management; model and agent evaluation; and AI safety and access controls. Proven ability to move solutions from proof of concept to stable, supportable production services. Experience integrating systems through APIs, SDKs, webhooks, identity services, or automation platforms. Working knowledge of enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and data-governance principles. Significant hands-on experience administering or engineering enterprise Saa S, collaboration, productivity, search, automation, or AI platforms. Practical experience with several of the following: Slack, Google Workspace, Gemini for Workspace, Glean, Claude, Chat GPT, or comparable enterprise AI products. Strong knowledge of systems-administration practices, including identity and access management, role-based permissions, configuration management, logging, monitoring, incident response, and change management. Strong troubleshooting, technical writing, architecture documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills. Ability to lead technically through expertise and influence without direct people-management authority. Familiarity with cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, source control, CI/CD, secrets management, and observability. Software development experience with Python, Type Script, Java Script, or similar languages. Experience creating MCP servers or integrating MCP-compatible clients and tools. Experience operating an enterprise AI platform or supporting an internal AI enablement program. Familiarity with responsible-AI practices, AI security frameworks, and model or agent evaluation methodologies.      Notes: No direct reports. vagas.title: Remote investment lawyer - brazil
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote investment lawyer - brazil em remote. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Específicos : Compreensão das particularidades e desafios relacionados às doenças raras e/ou à neurologia, bem como capacidade de atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Medical Affairs/MSL, Acesso, Operações e demais áreas envolvidas, contribuindo para o sucesso da estratégia do produto e, principalmente, para a jornada do paciente; Experiência:Experiência prévia no setor farmacêutico, preferencialmente em posições relacionadas à geração de demanda, promoção de produtos farmacêuticos e relacionamento com neurologistas, neurologistas pediátricos e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos na jornada do paciente. É desejável experiência comprovada em: * geração de demanda; * planejamento e execução de visitas; * gestão de território e contas; * relacionamento e engajamento com HCPs; * acesso ao mercado de saúde brasileiro; * atuação nos sistemas público e privado de saúde; * produtos de alta complexidade, neurologia e/ou doenças raras.Atribuições e Responsabilidades: * Planejar, personalizar e executar jornadas de engajamento para HCPs-alvo, considerando suas necessidades e preferências e utilizando adequadamente os conteúdos e canais de interação disponibilizados pela companhia. * Construir relacionamentos profissionais sólidos e sustentáveis com HCPs e demais stakeholders estratégicos, buscando estabelecer uma colaboração de longo prazo e gerar valor para os clientes, pacientes e para a Multicare. * Proporcionar uma experiência de excelência e centrada no cliente, compreendendo suas necessidades, seu ambiente de saúde e os desafios relacionados à jornada do paciente. * Utilizar de forma estratégica as fontes de dados e informações disponíveis para segmentar, priorizar e revisar continuamente o território, as contas e os planos de interação com clientes. * Desenvolver e executar planos de território e de contas, estabelecendo prioridades, objetivos, indicadores e ações necessárias para maximizar o potencial de cada região sob sua responsabilidade. * Identificar oportunidades e barreiras relacionadas ao diagnóstico, tratamento, acesso e jornada do paciente, compartilhando os insights relevantes com as áreas internas responsáveis. * Compartilhar continuamente percepções e insights dos clientes com os stakeholders internos pertinentes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de conteúdos, campanhas, estratégias e planos de interação relacionados ao produto e à sua indicação. * Trabalhar de maneira integrada com equipes multifuncionais, especialmente Medical Affairs/MSL, Acesso, Marketing e Operações, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções que atendam às necessidades identificadas no mercado. * Desenvolver e manter conhecimento aprofundado sobre o produto, sua indicação, o cenário terapêutico, a jornada do paciente, o ambiente competitivo e as particularidades do território sob sua responsabilidade. * Contribuir para a geração de demanda de forma responsável, sustentável e ética, respeitando rigorosamente as indicações aprovadas, as políticas internas da Multicare e todas as normas regulatórias e de compliance aplicáveis. * Monitorar sistematicamente os resultados e indicadores de performance de seu território, identificando desvios, oportunidades e ações necessárias para o atingimento dos objetivos estabelecidos. * Representar a Multicare perante médicos, instituições e demais stakeholders de maneira profissional, ética e compatível com os valores e padrões de excelência da companhia. * Agir permanentemente com integridade, transparência e respeito no relacionamento com clientes, pacientes, colegas e parceiros.PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS Buscamos profissionais ambiciosos, comprometidos e orientados a resultados, que desejem integrar um time de alta performance, atuando em um ambiente dinâmico, desafiador e estratégico. Procuramos pessoas com forte capacidade de execução, maturidade profissional, senso de responsabilidade e disposição para assumir protagonismo na gestão de seu território. Em um modelo de gestão de contas e territórios, o Consultor será responsável por liderar sua região com visão estratégica, disciplina de execução e foco em resultados, promovendo um elevado nível de engajamento com médicos e demais stakeholders. Esperamos uma atuação pautada por excelência, ética, compliance, colaboração multidisciplinar e foco permanente no paciente, contribuindo para ampliar o acesso a terapias inovadoras em neurologia e para consolidar a Multicare como um parceiro de confiança dos profissionais e instituições de saúde.
