About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

vagas.description:

O que buscamos:      Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.      Responsabilidades:     Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do Zero Layer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células). Implementar o Zero Layer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o Zero Layer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, m TLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de Ia C (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.    Requisitos Obrigatórios     Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture. Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud. Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map. Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção. APIs REST, g RPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, No SQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, Open ID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro    Desejável:     Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. Graph QL. Apache Pulsar, Rabbit MQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou. NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. Conhecimento de Terraform    Descrição comportamental:      Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.    Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.   #Vempra GFT   #Vamos Voar Juntos   #Proud To Be GFT

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Ai tech lead em gaspar. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Preferred Time Zone: CT      Must-Have Skills:    Demonstrated experience building and maintaining production-quality AI agents, skills, assistants, workflows, or integrations. Strong understanding of AI application concepts, including agents and agentic workflows; skills, tools, and function calling; Model Context Protocol; prompt and context design; retrieval-augmented generation; enterprise search and data connectors; grounding, citations, memory, and context management; model and agent evaluation; and AI safety and access controls. Proven ability to move solutions from proof of concept to stable, supportable production services. Experience integrating systems through APIs, SDKs, webhooks, identity services, or automation platforms. Working knowledge of enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and data-governance principles. Significant hands-on experience administering or engineering enterprise Saa S, collaboration, productivity, search, automation, or AI platforms. Practical experience with several of the following: Slack, Google Workspace, Gemini for Workspace, Glean, Claude, Chat GPT, or comparable enterprise AI products. Strong knowledge of systems-administration practices, including identity and access management, role-based permissions, configuration management, logging, monitoring, incident response, and change management. Strong troubleshooting, technical writing, architecture documentation, and stakeholder-communication skills. Ability to lead technically through expertise and influence without direct people-management authority.      Nice-to-Have Skills:    Experience with single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, OAuth, service accounts, delegated authorization, and enterprise identity providers. Familiarity with cloud platforms, infrastructure as code, source control, CI/CD, secrets management, and observability. Software development experience with Python, Type Script, Java Script, or similar languages. Experience creating MCP servers or integrating MCP-compatible clients and tools. Experience operating an enterprise AI platform or supporting an internal AI enablement program. Familiarity with responsible-AI practices, AI security frameworks, and model or agent evaluation methodologies.      Notes: No direct reports. This role is more leading through influence by setting standards, mentoring other admins/engineers, etc.      Strong preference in AI technology depth, with lighter platform administration experience rather than the other way around.    Scope of Work: The AI Platform Technical Lead is the hands-on technical owner of the organization's general-purpose, AI-enabled collaboration ecosystem, spanning Slack, Google Workspace with Gemini, Glean, and general-purpose AI assistants such as Claude and Chat GPT. Working within the strategy and priorities established by the organization, this role translates platform direction into secure, scalable, and supportable technical solutions. The Technical Lead configures, maintains, and improves these platforms based on data and feedback; builds agents and reusable skills; implements integrations; establishes technical patterns; and guides other contributors through technical expertise and example.    Key Responsibilities:   · Design, build, test, and maintain AI agents, skills, prompts, tools, workflows, and automations.   · Build AI solutions using MCP, function calling, APIs, agents, and integration frameworks.   · Translate business needs into technical designs, prototypes, and production-ready AI capabilities.   · Build secure integrations across Slack, Google Workspace/Gemini, Glean, AI assistants, and enterprise systems.   · Develop APIs, data connectors, webhooks, search integrations, and RAG/semantic-search solutions.   · Ensure AI systems preserve source-system permissions, access controls, data security, and governance requirements.   · Test and evaluate AI solutions for quality, reliability, safety, performance, and data grounding.   · Administer and optimize enterprise AI platforms, including access, configurations, integrations, monitoring, and lifecycle management.   · Troubleshoot complex AI platform, integration, connector, and data-retrieval issues.   · Establish standards for AI agents, integrations, configurations, testing, deployment, and security.   · Lead technical solution reviews, mentor contributors, and serve as the senior technical escalation point.   · Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and provide technical recommendations to platform leadership.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Company: Lime Vizio Inc.    Industry: Multi-Brand E-Commerce (US & Canada)    Location: Remote (outside the US)    Schedule: Full-time, Los Angeles business hours    Reports to: CEO & Founders      About Lime Vizio    Lime Vizio is a multi-brand e-commerce company operating across the United States and Canada.    We build and grow digital businesses in flowers, gifting, and local services, processing thousands of orders through proprietary technology, performance marketing, AI, and operational excellence.    We're looking for an experienced E-Commerce Director to drive profitable growth—not just increase traffic.    About the Role    You'll own the end-to-end digital customer journey across multiple brands, from acquisition through checkout, retention, and repeat purchase.    This is a commercial leadership role focused on improving conversion, customer experience, merchandising, experimentation, and profitability.    Success is measured by business outcomes—not website activity.    What You'll Own E-commerce growth strategy Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Customer journey & UX Merchandising & pricing Checkout optimization A/B testing & experimentation Retention (Email & SMS) SEO commercial performance AI-powered shopping experiences Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Analytics, and Operations  Key Responsibilities Increase gross profit, conversion rate, AOV, retention, and profit per visitor. Build and execute the e-commerce growth roadmap. Lead CRO and experimentation programs. Improve customer experience across desktop and mobile. Optimize merchandising, pricing, promotions, bundles, and upsells. Improve customer retention and lifecycle marketing. Work with PPC and SEO teams to maximize profitable growth. Introduce AI-driven shopping and personalization where it creates measurable business value. Prioritize initiatives based on commercial impact rather than activity.    Success Metrics    You'll be accountable for measurable improvements in:   Gross Profit Profit per Visitor Conversion Rate Average Order Value Checkout Completion Repeat Purchase Rate Customer Lifetime Value Incremental Profit from Experiments  Requirements 7+ years in E-commerce, CRO, Growth, or Digital Commerce. 3+ years in an e-commerce leadership role. Strong in-house e-commerce experience (required). Proven success improving conversion, AOV, retention, or profitability. Experience leading CRO, experimentation, merchandising, and customer journey optimization. Strong understanding of unit economics and commercial performance. Experience working with Product, Engineering, PPC, SEO, Design, and Analytics teams. Excellent English (B2+). Available during Los Angeles business hours. Based outside the United States.  Nice to Have Multi-brand e-commerce Marketplace businesses High-volume online retail Woo Commerce or Shopify AI-powered personalization Behavioral psychology Seasonal or event-driven commerce  This Role Is Not for Someone Who Only manages website content. Focuses on traffic instead of profit. Relies entirely on agencies. Treats CRO as visual redesign. Reports problems without owning implementation. Measures success through clicks instead of commercial performance.  What We Offer Remote, long-term leadership role. Direct partnership with the CEO and founders. Ownership of commercial growth strategy. Fast decision-making with minimal bureaucracy. Opportunity to scale multiple e-commerce brands using data, experimentation, and AI.

About i QIYI    i QIYI International is a global digital entertainment platform focused on Asian dramas, films, animation, variety shows and other content for international audiences. In Brazil and Latin America, we are building partnerships with leading media, telecom, digital platforms and brands to make Asian entertainment more accessible to local audiences.      Role purpose    Support i QIYI’s expansion in Brazil and Latin America by prospecting, developing and coordinating commercial and marketing partnerships. The role requires the ability to independently organize priorities, lead meetings, prepare proposals, follow up on opportunities and coordinate projects with external partners and internal teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia, without constant supervision.      Key responsibilities   1. Business Development & Partnerships – approximately 70% Map, prospect and develop relationships with private and public free-to-air broadcasters, telecommunications operators, digital and OTT platforms, distributors, technology companies, payment providers, retailers, consumer brands and other strategic partners. Build and maintain an organized pipeline of potential partners in Brazil and other Latin American markets, documenting contacts, opportunity stages, next steps, risks and timelines. Prepare presentations, commercial proposals, preliminary partnership models, meeting minutes, progress reports and decision-support materials. Lead initial meetings, identify partner needs and develop value propositions suited to different cooperation models. Support negotiations involving content distribution, licensing, revenue sharing, subscription bundles, media/barter, co-marketing, customer benefits, promotions and other commercial models. Negotiate commercial terms within approved parameters and coordinate validation with the Country Manager and relevant i QIYI functions; final approvals and signatures remain with management and headquarters. Coordinate the progress of opportunities with internal content, marketing, product, technology, legal, finance, operations and other teams in Brazil, Canada and Asia. Support partnership implementation after approval, ensuring alignment on scope, deliverables, timelines and performance indicators. Conduct research on markets, competitors, potential partners and trends across streaming, television, telecommunications and entertainment in Latin America. Represent i QIYI in partner meetings, industry events and business visits, with availability for occasional travel within Brazil and Latin America. 2. Marketing Partnerships – approximately 30% Identify and structure marketing opportunities with commercial partners to promote the i QIYI brand, priority content launches and subscription offers. Plan and coordinate co-marketing initiatives, partner campaigns, events, activations, content promotion and online/offline promotional projects. Adapt global briefs and materials to the needs of Brazil and other Latin American markets, ensuring local relevance and compliance with brand guidelines. Coordinate deliverables with internal and external stakeholders, including partners, agencies, public relations teams, influencers and vendors when applicable. Track execution and results, gather evidence of delivery and prepare reports with learnings and recommendations.      Required qualifications At least 3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, commercial roles, partnership marketing or related functions. Hands-on experience in B2 B prospecting, relationship management, proposal preparation and follow-up of negotiations or partner projects. Fluent or native Portuguese. Professional English, with the ability to participate in meetings, prepare presentations and communicate with international teams. Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, set priorities, meet deadlines and keep stakeholders informed. Strong verbal and written communication, negotiation, organization and relationship-building skills. Availability to collaborate across time zones and travel occasionally within Brazil and Latin America. Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, International Relations, Economics or a related field. Proficiency in Power Point/Google Slides and Excel/Google Sheets; familiarity with CRM and project-management tools is preferred.    Preferred qualifications Experience in streaming, entertainment, television, media, telecommunications, technology or digital platforms. Professional Spanish for communication with partners across Latin America. Existing relationships with broadcasters, telecom operators, platforms, agencies, brands or other potential partners. Experience working in multicultural environments and with international headquarters or regional teams. Knowledge of licensing, revenue-share, subscription bundles, co-marketing and media/barter models. Mandarin Chinese. Experience working with Chinese companies and a strong understanding of Chinese corporate culture will be considered a distinct advantage.    Employment conditions and benefits Permanent CLT employment agreement. Initially remote work, with the possibility that the work model may be reviewed in the future, including hybrid or office-based arrangements, in accordance with business needs, company policy and applicable law. Quarterly bonus in accordance with company policy and individual/corporate performance. Health insurance plan, meal/food allowance and life insurance. 30 calendar days of paid annual leave, 13th-month salary, FGTS, INSS and other statutory benefits under Brazilian law. Applicable statutory leave and occupational health examinations.

Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager      Company Overview:    b Td Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. b Td operates under three innovative models:  B2 C (exclusive membership services),  B2 B (corporate travel management), and  B2 B2 C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2 B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our  b Td Corp Tool .    This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to  b Td travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.      CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)    We are looking for two (2)  CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.      Main Responsibilities   • Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.   • Handle client requests, changes, and special services via Whats App and email.   • Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.   • Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.   • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction. Spanish is a plus.   • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.   Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages. Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required. Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach. Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively. • Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus      Why Join Us   • Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.   • Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.   • Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.   • Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements      b Td Travel Culture:    At b Td, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.    b Td is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside b Td, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.      Terms of Employment: Employment under  CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) . Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where b Td operates. This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility. Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.    Compensation: Competitive base salary. Night shift extra hours Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs. Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets. Health and dental insurance. Food card. Birthday day off. Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to  Head of Corporate Globally as b Td evolves through its funding rounds. Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the b Td team.    Important Note Before Applying:    Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your  Linked In profile or  updated resume . If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together. Diferenciais Experiência com treinamento corporativo no segmento automotivo. Vivência em programas de desenvolvimento de lideranças. Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem Experiência na utilização de plataformas de aprendizagem e ferramentas digitais de treinamento.    Competências Comportamentais Comunicação e influência. Facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal. Protagonismo e senso de dono. Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos. Pensamento analítico e visão de negócio. Colaboração e trabalho em equipe. Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade. Mentalidade de crescimento (Growth Mindset). vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Account manager em itatiba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We're Convert Sail, an e-commerce conversion optimization agency. We work with Shopify brands spending $100 K-$1 M+/month on ads, and we move fast. Really fast.      We're looking for an Account Manager to own client relationships and project delivery. You'll manage 8-10 client accounts, coordinate landing page and funnel builds with our design and dev team, and be the main point of contact when clients need something.      This isn't a 9-5 role where you clock out and forget about work. When a client has a launch on Saturday, you're online. When a project is behind, you stay late to fix it. We ship fast, we work weekends when it matters, and most people flame out in the first 90 days because they can't handle the pace.      If that scares you, this isn't the role for you.      If that excites you, keep reading.      What you'll do:     Own 8-10 client relationships and make sure they're happy, on track, and renewing long-term Manage day-to-day client communication and set clear expectations Coordinate landing page and funnel projects with our design and dev team—keep timelines tight and make sure nothing slips Proactively identify and solve client issues before they become fires Track project progress in Click Up and ensure deadlines are met Help clients see ROI from our work so they stick around for 6-12+ months, not 2-3 Be available during USA business hours and occasionally on weekends when client launches require it    What we're looking for:     2+ years of experience managing client accounts in a fast-paced agency, Saa S company, or startup Fluent English speaker with strong written and verbal communication skills You've worked in high-pressure environments before and didn't crack under the weight You're organized, proactive, and don't need someone checking in on you every 2 hours You don't let things fall through the cracks—you follow up, you track details, you close loops Experience with project management tools like Click Up, Asana, or similar Comfortable working remotely, but you don't treat \"remote\" like \"invisible\" Bonus: Experience with e-commerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization (not required, but helpful)    What we offer:     Compensation: $12/hour ($2,000+/month full-time) + performance bonuses (depending on experience) Fully remote—work from anywhere as long as you're available US hours Work with real scaling brands, not broke startups or tire-kickers Small team, so you'll have real impact and visibility You'll learn more in 6 months here than 2 years at a slow-moving corporate job Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the agency scales    How to apply:      Don't send a resume first.      Record a 4-minute Loom video (free tool, Google it if you don't know it) and tell us:     Why you want this job Why we should hire you A time you had to manage a difficult client situation and how you handled it    Then email the Loom link to:      Subject line must include the word BUILDER. If it doesn't, we'll assume you can't follow instructions and we won't read your application.      If you can't handle recording a 4-minute video, you definitely can't handle this role.

Estou buscando uma pessoa para entrar comigo como sócio na próxima fase do Critério Político, uma plataforma de inteligência de dados públicos voltada ao mercado político e institucional.      O produto já existe e foi desenvolvido por mim com uso de IA somada minha expertise de +15 anos atuando como Gerente de Projetos em empresas de tecnologia, do zero, incluindo arquitetura, desenvolvimento e integrações.      Agora quero transformar o projeto em uma operação comercial.      O que procuro    Uma pessoa com perfil empreendedor, comercial e estratégico, que tenha interesse real em construir um negócio de tecnologia.      Experiência ou relacionamento com algum desses mercados será um diferencial:      Política    Governo    Gov Tech    Relações institucionais    Saa S    Dados e inteligência    Vendas B2 B    Marketing e desenvolvimento de negócios      O que espero do sócio    A ideia é construir uma sociedade de verdade.      O parceiro poderá participar através de uma combinação de:      aporte financeiro + atuação comercial/estratégica + participação societária.      O valor do aporte e o percentual de participação serão definidos em conjunto, considerando o estágio atual do produto, o capital investido e a contribuição de cada sócio.      O que já existe   ✓ Produto desenvolvido e funcional   ✓ Tecnologia própria   ✓ Plataforma de dados públicos   ✓ Integrações com fontes públicas   ✓ Estrutura pronta para evolução   ✓ Possibilidade de diferentes modelos de monetização   ✓ Potencial de expansão para mercado político, institucional e Gov Tech      Não estou procurando um funcionário.      Estou procurando alguém que queira construir o negócio comigo e disposto a investir parte do que já foi construído para trilharmos os próximos passos.      Se você tem experiência comercial, capital, relacionamento ou conhecimento de mercado e acredita que podemos transformar o Critério Político em uma empresa relevante, quero conversar. Vou conversar pessoalmente com os interessados e apresentar o produto, o estágio atual e a proposta de sociedade ou até mesmo venda total da inteligência e produto, caso haja interesse.

vagas.title: Vendedor de sorvetes (diversas regiões do brasil)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Vendedor de sorvetes (diversas regiões do brasil) em guarulhos. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

A vida fica melhor com sorvete    Com 19.000 especialistas em sorvetes e marcas icônicas como Kibon, Cornetto e Ben & Jerry’s, amadas em 76 países, somos a maior empresa de sorvetes do mundo e líder do setor. Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.      A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada.      Sobre a Função    Seu propósito será impulsionar a presença, o abastecimento e a visibilidade de Kibon no ponto de venda, executando o roteiro definido e assegurando os padrões de execução, para gerar crescimento sustentável da carteira e experiência de compra diferenciada.      Responsabilidades Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital. Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos; Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução; realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos; remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos. Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira. Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo. Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas; utilizar os insights de vendas para priorização e melhoria de execução. Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro. Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos. Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente. Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais. Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.    Qualificações Ensino médio completo Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento. Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial. Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros). CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.    Por que se juntar a nós?    Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:     Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade. Vencemos juntos, com diversão. Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria. Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.  Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!      Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.      Oferecemos Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível. Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas. Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce. Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.    VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?    Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Sua candidatura será analisada de acordo com os requisitos da vaga, e entraremos em contato após o encerramento do processo para informar o status da sua inscrição.      Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e precisar de apoio em qualquer etapa do nosso processo de recrutamento, entre em contato com o seu Talent Acquisition Partner.      Empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades      A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é uma empresa comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. Não toleramos qualquer forma de discriminação, inclusive com base em deficiência.

vagas.title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em indaiatuba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Us      Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.      At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.      Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.      Role Overview      As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.      Key Responsibilities     1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.   2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.   3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble   4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.   Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.   5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.   6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.   7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.   8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology   9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.   10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.      Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.      Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.      Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

vagas.title: Professor de inglês
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Professor de inglês em anápolis. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!      Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!      A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.      Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.      Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.     *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*      O que oferecemos?     Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.    Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?      Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .      Necessário:     Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.    O diferencial?      Aqui você é mais que um professor.      Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.      Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.      Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.      Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.      Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!      O que eu faço?     Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as    Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.      QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?     Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.    Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.      Seja diferente, seja independente

vagas.description:

We're hiring someone who walks into a room of founders and owns it by minute two.      R$14,700 to R$20,600 Monthly | Brazil, remote (Rio de Janeiro preferred) | Unlimited PTO      The role    You inherit a training program and a community that already work, and you are handed full ownership of both. From there it is yours: what gets taught and to whom, how the community runs, where the whole thing goes next. You teach live every week to founders betting their company on Microsoft Marketplace, and you own the number that says it landed. A real program to run and grow, not a blank page and not somebody else's to approve.      You'll join a marketing team of four (designer, growth marketer, content marketer), report to the Head of Marketing, and work daily with Customer Success, Account Managers, and Partnerships.      Who we're looking for    Someone who loves to teach and misses it when they stop. You can hold a room of CEOs, marketing and sales directors in English, and take a hard question without losing the thread. You come from B2 B sales, marketing, or startups, so the room recognizes you as one of them.      What you'll own     1. The program The curriculum plan: what gets taught, in what order, to whom Live delivery, on camera, weekly Learning design: objectives, exercises, assessment, not slides The metric that proves it worked, and the rewrite when it didn't 2. The community Programming calendar, member journey, moderation standard Engaged participation as the number, not signups Members turned into content contributors Recurring interviews with our CEO, partners, and customers    What you bring 3-5 years teaching or running education programs. B2 B Saa S strongly preferred End-to-end ownership of a training program, not delivery only Live teaching to a business audience Community building: a peer network, user group, or alumni cohort Hands-on with GTM tooling, enough to teach while using it AI in your daily workflow, with the judgment to review it. Raw AI output doesn't ship here    Nice to have Microsoft partner, cloud marketplace, or co-sell motion GTM tools: Clay, Apollo, Lemlist Instructional design or adult learning LMS and community platforms: Circle, Teachable, Skilljar Portuguese, French, or Spanish fluency    Details R$14,700 to R$20,600 per month, plus an end-of-year bonus Two recordings of trainings you have delivered in English, requested with your application Professional English (only English CVs will be considered)    About We Transact    Most companies in our space raise tens of millions and burn it chasing this market. We bootstrapped, turned a profit, and built the software that 500+ companies now use to sell through Microsoft. Titles don't matter here. Accountability does, and so does winning as a team.

vagas.title: Data specialist (with advanced english)
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Data specialist (with advanced english) em pinhais. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Us:    Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.    Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.    We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.      About the Role:    We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.    See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!      As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package    Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.        We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.          Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

vagas.description:

Sobre a vaga  Se você já perdeu o sono acompanhando uma liquidez secar numa DEX às 3h da manhã, ou já organizou uma migração de fundos entre cold wallets sem deixar ninguém dormir tranquilo até a confirmação final na blockchain — essa vaga é para você. Não é uma posição para quem está começando na área. É uma função de responsabilidade real, com acesso a ativos reais, decisões que importam e impacto direto no negócio. O que você vai fazer   Executar e supervisionar operações em exchanges centralizadas (CEX) e descentralizadas (DEX) — negociação, transferências, liquidez e reconciliação Gerenciar hot wallets e cold wallets no dia a dia, garantindo segurança operacional sem travar a velocidade do negócio Administrar estruturas multi-sig e processos de custódia, incluindo definição e revisão de políticas de acesso e aprovação Monitorar exposição, saldos e movimentações de ativos cripto em tempo real Criar e aprimorar processos internos de controle, segurança e auditoria para operações com criptoativos Atuar como referência técnica em questões de segurança de carteiras, gestão de chaves e prevenção de perdas Trabalhar em conjunto com times de compliance, financeiro e tecnologia para manter as operações sólidas e escaláveis Requisitos Experiência comprovada operando em exchanges cripto, tanto CEX quanto DEX Vivência prática com carteiras digitais — hot wallets, cold wallets, soluções multi-sig e custódia de ativos Histórico real de gestão de operações com criptoativos (não apenas conhecimento teórico) Rigor com segurança operacional: você entende que um erro nessa área pode custar caro, literalmente Autonomia para tomar decisões e comunicar com clareza em ambientes de alta responsabilidade Inglês para comunicação técnica é um diferencial O que oferecemos Remuneração: US$ 130.000 a US$ 150.000 por ano Plano de saúde completo , sem letras miúdas Modelo de trabalho flexível: remoto ou híbrido, conforme sua preferência Autonomia real para estruturar e melhorar processos, não apenas executar Um time que já entende do assunto — sem precisar explicar o que é gas fee  Não importa a cor da pele, raça, gênero, orientação sexual ou qualquer outra característica pessoal. Se você respira mercado cripto e sabe a diferença entre segurança de verdade e segurança de fachada, queremos falar com você.

Nova oportunidade para Dgb americas training manager south latam em limeira. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

DGB Americas Training Manager – South LATAM    DOLCE & GABBANA Beauty    Location : Brazil    Reporting to: Education Senior Manager      Role Mission    We are seeking a dynamic, strategic, and hands-on Training Manager to lead all education initiatives across South LATAM. This individual will be responsible for elevating brand knowledge, retail excellence, and client experience across Fragrance, Makeup, and Skincare categories    The role acts as the regional guardian of training excellence, ensuring that all distributor and travel retail markets are aligned with global brand standards while adapting programs to local needs. This person will not only execute training programs but also build long-term capabilities within distributor teams, driving sell-out performance and brand desirability in the region.      Key Responsibilities   1. Regional Training Strategy & Execution Own and execute the education strategy across South LATAM distributors and TR markets for fragrance, makeup, and skincare categories. Adapt global training materials into impactful, locally relevant training modules (in-person and digital). Develop and manage the regional training calendar, ensuring alignment with product launches and commercial priorities. Deliver high-quality training across key markets, ensuring consistency and excellence in execution. Manage the training budget for the region, ensuring efficient allocation of resources aligned with business priorities. Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.   2. Distributor Partnership & Capability Building Act as the main education liaison for distributors across South LATAM. Train and coach local trainers and retail teams to ensure scalable knowledge transfer. Track training effectiveness through KPIs (sell-out, engagement, certification rates) and implement improvements. Tailor training approaches based on market maturity, cultural nuances, and business needs.   3. Brand & Product Expertise Serve as the regional expert across fragrance, makeup, and skincare, ensuring deep product and brand storytelling knowledge. Lead all training-related aspects of product launches, ensuring teams are fully prepared prior to market activation. Elevate in-store execution standards through coaching on client experience, selling techniques, and service rituals.   4. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with Sales and Marketing teams to align training initiatives with business objectives and sell-out targets. vagas.title: Qc analyst - audio content - brazil

Nova oportunidade para Qc analyst - audio content - brazil em jacareí. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us      Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.      At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.      Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.      Role Overview      As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.      Key Responsibilities     1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.   2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.   3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble   4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.   Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.   5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.   6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.   7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.   8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology   9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.   10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.      Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.      Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.      Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

vagas.title: Remote commercial lawyer - brazil
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Remote commercial lawyer - brazil em bauru. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms
