vagas.title: Senior fpga developer
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Senior fpga developer em sumaré. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Company : Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. A leader in light management technologies for 3 D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. Employees working on this project are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.        About the Role : We are seeking a Principal/Staff-level FPGA Engineer — a recognized technical authority — to own FPGA architecture for our state-of-the-art Communications Test & Measurement products.        Responsibilities :     The successful candidate will define and drive end-to-end FPGA architecture, including make/buy tradeoffs on IP, floorplanning and timing closure strategy for multi-gigabit designs, and DFX approach, using Verilog/System Verilog/VHDL and industry-leading simulation, synthesis, place-and-route, and formal/UVM verification tools. This person will serve as the final technical escalation point for FPGA design and debug issues across the team, mentor other FPGA engineers, and lead root-cause debug of silicon and board bring-up issues that could not be resolved elsewhere.    Qualifications :     BS or MS degree in Electrical and/or Computer Engineering with a minimum of 12-15 years of relevant experience, including at least 5+ years specifically architecting and closing timing on multi-Gbps Ser Des/transceiver-based FPGA designs.    Required Skills :     Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing high-speed FPGA designs using Verilog/System Verilog and/or VHDL required. Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs — including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates — required (not incidental exposure). Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10 M to 1.6 T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs. Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products. Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (Vo IP, IPTV). Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques. Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches. Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary. Version control experience using Git or similar tools. Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world. Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.    Preferred Skills : Languages: English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Today, the club competes in the 8th tier of English football and is backed by an ambitious group of investors committed to building a sustainable, community-driven club with long-term growth potential. Our vision is to earn promotion through the English football pyramid and ultimately reach the English Football League through strategic investment, strong leadership, and community engagement. Westfield FC also competes in FA Cup and FA Trophy qualifying matches each season, providing exciting opportunities to showcase the club on a national stage while pursuing success both on and off the pitch.      Company Website:      About the Role: Member of the Board of Advisors      Westfield FC is seeking accomplished professionals, entrepreneurs, sports executives, investors, and football enthusiasts to join our Board of Advisors. Advisors will help promote the club, expand our network, identify strategic opportunities, and support the long-term growth of Westfield FC. This is an opportunity to become part of an ambitious ownership group working to build a successful football club for generations to come.      We are also actively seeking advisors from Brazil to help represent and support Westfield FC within their local market and networks.      Key Responsibilities     Promote Westfield FC within your professional and personal network. Introduce potential sponsors, commercial partners, investors, and strategic relationships. Interest in sports investing, football operations, sponsorships, or community development. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.    Compensation & Benefits      This advisory role offers sweat equity aligned with advisor contributions and the long-term success of Westfield FC. Advisors will have the opportunity to help shape the strategic direction of the club, work alongside the ownership group, expand their network within the football industry, and participate in an exciting football investment journey.      Why Join Us      Join an ambitious ownership group building a historic football club with a bold long-term vision. Inspired by stories like Welcome to Wrexham, our goal is to build a sustainable, community-focused club capable of climbing the English football pyramid and ultimately reaching the English Football League. If you’ve ever wanted to help shape the future of a football club from the inside while sharing in its long-term success, this is a unique opportunity.      Equal Opportunity Statement      Westfield FC is an equal opportunity organization. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive, and respectful environment and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Data specialist (with advanced english) em navegantes. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Us:    Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.    Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.    We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.      About the Role:    We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.    See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!      As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes.    You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have a strong ownership mentality — you want to ensure our products are the best in the world and take personal responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks You have strong attention to detail and produce work with minimal errors You communicate clearly, both orally and in writing — including proactively sharing progress, blockers, and updates You strive to make tasks as efficient as possible and are excited about using AI and tooling to work smarter You can manage multiple priorities and stay organized You are experimental and curious — energized by learning and not afraid to change the status quo You are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company    What We Offer:    Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary: We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, team events and more! Your growth at Yipit Data is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at Yipit Data is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Personal laptop Health and wellness package    Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.        We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.          Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents. Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes. International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows. Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR. A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.    Por que se juntar a nós?    Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:     Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.  Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)    Position Type: Full-Time or Part-Time Contract    Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)    Reports To: CRO / Founder    Language Requirement: Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)      We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC and a expanding presence in Brazil (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities. In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.    Key Responsibilities:   1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations: Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., Quick Books Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize). Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Track intercompany transactions (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office). 2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR): Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable. Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese. 3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements: Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors. Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports. Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure). 4. Data Integrity & Reporting: Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.  Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory): 3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices. Language Fluency: Flawless written and spoken English (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese (for local operations, banks, and agencies). Technical Proficiency: Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (Quick Books, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets. Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais, basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.  What We Offer: 100% remote working environment with flexibility. Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.

vagas.title: Retail credit risk manager
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Retail credit risk manager em itaquaquecetuba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Revolut    People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.    As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.      About the role    Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.    We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.      What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability    What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English    Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.    Important notice for candidates:    Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.   • Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.   • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.    We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.    By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

vagas.title: Arquitetura de soluções azure - 134713
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Arquitetura de soluções azure - 134713 em sumaré. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

O que buscamos:      Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.      Responsabilidades:     Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do Zero Layer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células). Implementar o Zero Layer Router (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o Zero Layer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, m TLS). Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider. Estabelecer padrões de Ia C (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável). Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada. Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio. Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs. Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.    Requisitos Obrigatórios     Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture. Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud. Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map. Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção. APIs REST, g RPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos. Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes. Bancos relacionais, No SQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding. OAuth2, Open ID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade. Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs). Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs. Experiência no setor Financeiro    Desejável:     Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture. CQRS. Event Sourcing. Saga Pattern. Outbox Pattern. Consumer Driven Contracts. Graph QL. Apache Pulsar, Rabbit MQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria. Java, Go ou. NET. Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS). Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102). TOGAF. Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas. Conhecimento de Terraform    Descrição comportamental:      Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições; Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento; Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina; Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ; Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ; Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.    Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.   #Vempra GFT   #Vamos Voar Juntos   #Proud To Be GFT

vagas.title: Remote m&a lawyer - brazil
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Remote m&a lawyer - brazil em araucária. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

vagas.title: Professor de francês
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Professor de francês em pato branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!      Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!      A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.      Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.      Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.     *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*      O que oferecemos?     Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. vagas.title: Remote privacy lawyer - brazil
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Remote privacy lawyer - brazil em flores da cunha. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents. Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes. International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows. Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR. A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

Nova oportunidade para Remote m&a lawyer - brazil em pinhais. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Se você respira mercado cripto e sabe a diferença entre segurança de verdade e segurança de fachada, queremos falar com você.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.      At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.      Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.      Role Overview      As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.      Key Responsibilities     1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files) Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.   2. Script-to-Audio Alignment Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.   3. Technical & Creative Accuracy Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble   4. Vendor & Artist Coordination Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.   Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.   5. QC Documentation & Tracking Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.   6. Pre-Release Quality Checks Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.   7. Cross-Team Collaboration Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.   8. Process Improvement Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology   9. Volume & Deadline Management Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.   10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery    Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.      Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.      Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.    Language requirements Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English    This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.      Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.      Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil.       Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.      Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:      A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.      Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.      Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento. vagas.title: Promo writer (brasil)
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em marília. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Promo Writer    Location: Remote    Position Type: Contract    Company: Pocket FM    About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.    Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.    The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.    You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.      Key Responsibilities     1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.    They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

vagas.title: Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno
vagas.description:

Sobre a Payfy  A Payfy é uma fintech B2 B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte.    Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.     Sobre a vaga:  Designer de Conteúdo com IA é quem projeta, produz e publica o conteúdo da nossa plataforma de transformação com IA para times financeiros — do começo ao fim.    Projetar vem primeiro, e é o que define a função: pensar a pauta antes de executá-la, decidir se ela vira carrossel ou vídeo, onde ela entra no calendário e o que precisa dizer. Depois vem a execução — desenhar a peça, editar o vídeo, escrever a copy e colocar no ar. Tudo com a mesma pessoa, do início ao fim.      É uma posição nova no mercado e já é realidade aqui: a Payfy tem profissionais no time atuando exatamente assim.      O que torna esse escopo possível é a forma como a gente trabalha. Ferramentas de IA generativa (Claude/Claude Design, entre outras) estão na rotina diária e absorvem a parte mecânica da execução — variações de peça, primeiro corte, versões de copy, adaptação de formato. Some a isso um acervo de vídeo já montado (padrões de título, vinheta, GC, mockups, backgrounds animados) e um sistema visual definido: você quase nunca começa do zero.      Por isso o perfil é generalista: repertório em design, vídeo e social media, e critério para decidir o que publicar, em que ordem e com que cara. É aí que seu tempo vai — o trabalho braçal fica com a IA.    Você vai ter autonomia real sobre a operação e apoio direto de quem já construiu todo o padrão visual e narrativo da marca.      O que você vai fazer:    Calendário e planejamento   Montar o calendário editorial mensal Traduzir temas, lançamentos e novidades da plataforma em pautas de conteúdo Manter a régua de publicação rodando de forma previsível, sem depender de demanda chegar  Produção visual   Criar carrosséis, posts estáticos, stories e peças para mídia paga dentro da identidade da marca Produzir capas de conteúdo para a plataforma (cursos, aulas, eventos) Manter rigor estético e consistência de marca em tudo que sai  Vídeo   Editar as videoaulas e conteúdos diversos a partir de um acervo de assets já prontos Realizar cortes, encaixes, montagem e exportação Apoiar novas gravações quando entrarem no calendário  Publicação e acompanhamento   Agendar e publicar via MLabs e canais próprios Conferir se a postagem subiu, se ficou correta, se precisa de ajuste Contribuir com ideias para materiais ricos (e-books, planilhas, ferramentas usadas como isca)    O que a gente espera de você:    Requisitos   Experiência prévia montando calendários de social media (não apenas executando peças) Experiência prévia editando vídeo — domínio dos princípios de enquadramento, ritmo e montagem Boas noções de design: hierarquia, contraste, uso de cor, composição. Você não precisa desenhar do zero, mas precisa saber enxergar quando algo está errado Boa escrita: headlines, copy de post, roteiro Disciplina para trabalho remoto — organização própria, cumprimento de prazos, comunicação ativa Disposição real para aprender ferramentas de IA e mudar a forma de trabalhar    O perfil que a gente procura   Visão macro de projetos Autonomia: pegar uma pauta e levá-la até a publicação, sem precisar de briefing mastigado a cada passo Organização e consistência Senso de dono    Diferenciais   Experiência com Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Cap Cut Familiaridade com Figma, Notion, MLabs Já ter usado ferramentas de IA generativa para produção de conteúdo Conhecimento de boas práticas de You Tube (SEO de descrição, configuração de publicação, leitura de retenção) Repertório em finanças/B2 B    Como é trabalhar aqui:   Remoto de verdade, com rituais definidos: alinhamento semanal com o time e encontros de acompanhamento com o gestor direto ao longo da semana Aprendizado estruturado, você vai lapidar seus conhecimentos em: MLabs, boas práticas de IA aplicada a conteúdo, padrão de edição dos vídeos, produto e marca Espaço para crescer    Processo seletivo:   Inscrição e triagem de currículo — RH Envio de portfólio — 3 peças autorais, sendo obrigatoriamente uma delas um vídeo editado por você Teste perfil comportamental (DISC) — RH Desafio prático — um projeto integrado e realista: uma peça de design, um carrossel, um vídeo curto e a copy/headline que amarra tudo, a partir de um tema que a gente entrega. O que a gente avalia aqui é sobretudo o raciocínio: como você estruturou o conjunto, não só o acabamento de cada peça Entrevista técnica — com o gestor direto, junto com a devolutiva do desafio Entrevista de liderança — com a liderança de Marketing    O que oferecemos   Contrato CLT — R$ 4.000,00 Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses) Day off de aniversário Wellhub + Conexa Saúde Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia    Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy    Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade.      Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.    Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

vagas.title: Promo writer (brasil)
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Promo writer (brasil) em passo fundo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Promo Writer    Location: Remote    Position Type: Contract    Company: Pocket FM    About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.    Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.    The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.    You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.      Key Responsibilities     1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.    They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.    About the role    At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.    We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.    Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.    Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.
