About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Promo writer (brasil) em toledo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Promo Writer    Location: Remote    Position Type: Contract    Company: Pocket FM    About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.    Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.    The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.    You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.      Key Responsibilities     1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series. Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance. Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series. Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production. Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series. 2. Adaptation & Localization Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese. Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience. Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market. Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts. 3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity. Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments. Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction. Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards. 4. Production-Ready Script Delivery Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required. Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute. Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed. Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution. 5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement. Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization. Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos. Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance. 6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams. Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines. Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets. Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response. 7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization Use Gen AI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement. Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards. Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength. Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field. Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content. Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences. Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese. Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers. Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred. Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams. Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables. Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment. Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.    They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's real estate work in Brazil: commercial leases, sale and purchase agreements, real estate aspects of corporate transactions, and development and construction agreements. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of leases and property transaction documents for clients ranging from startups taking their first office to enterprises managing property portfolios. Run title review and property due diligence, including for real estate elements of M& A and financing transactions. Advise on real estate financing and security, planning and zoning questions, and landlord-tenant matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial real estate law in private practice or in-house. Leasing depth. Office, retail, industrial, and flexible-space leases — rent review, service charges, repair obligations, break options, and assignments. Transactional experience. Sale and purchase agreements, title review and due diligence, conditions, and completion mechanics. Financing familiarity. Mortgages, security packages, and the real estate workstreams of corporate deals. Practical judgment. You separate the points that protect the client from the points that stall the deal. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Bring speed and clarity to real estate transactions traditionally slowed by process. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.    Por que se juntar a nós?    Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:     Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade. Vencemos juntos, com diversão. Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria. Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.  Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível! Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce. Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.    VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?    Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. vagas.title: Vendedor de sorvetes (diversas regiões do brasil)
vagas.description:
Empresa está contratando Vendedor de sorvetes (diversas regiões do brasil) em são josé dos pinhais. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A vida fica melhor com sorvete    Com 19.000 especialistas em sorvetes e marcas icônicas como Kibon, Cornetto e Ben & Jerry’s, amadas em 76 países, somos a maior empresa de sorvetes do mundo e líder do setor. Levamos o prazer a sério há mais de 100 anos, proporcionando felicidade a cada lambida ou bola de sorvete e criando momentos especiais para gerações.      A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é movida pelo crescimento: crescemos nosso negócio, impulsionamos o crescimento dos negócios dos nossos clientes e desenvolvemos a carreira das nossas pessoas. O crescimento começa com o empoderamento. Por isso, damos aos nossos colaboradores a liberdade para agir como empreendedores inovadores e responsáveis, motivados e preparados para oferecer aos nossos consumidores produtos excepcionais e momentos inesquecíveis — e se divertir ao longo dessa jornada.      Sobre a Função    Seu propósito será impulsionar a presença, o abastecimento e a visibilidade de Kibon no ponto de venda, executando o roteiro definido e assegurando os padrões de execução, para gerar crescimento sustentável da carteira e experiência de compra diferenciada.      Responsabilidades Vendedor de Sorvetes é responsável por execução operacional e presença de Kibon nos PDVs da rota, com média de 20 visitas/dia, garantindo abastecimento, visibilidade, layout e precificação, excelência em Loja Brilhante, registro no Sistema de Vendas e estímulo ao pedido via Digital. Roteiro & Produtividade: visitar em média 20 clientes por dia com disciplina e pontualidade, garantindo cobertura integral da carteira e continuidade dos atendimentos; Execução de Loja: assegurar abastecimento, layout, precificação e materiais de visibilidade conforme guia de execução; realizar limpeza e conservação dos equipamentos; remover produtos estranho / danificados e / ou produtos que não sejam Kibon e que estejam presentes nos equipamentos. Carteira: atua sob orientação e com responsabilidade direta pelos resultados da carteira. Loja Brilhante: realizar a pesquisa de Loja Brilhante com evidências (fotos) e registrar a execução no aplicativo corporativo. Sistemas & Dados: abrir/fechar visitas, registrar pedidos, ocorrências e evidências no sistema de vendas; utilizar os insights de vendas para priorização e melhoria de execução. Pontos Quentes: negociar o melhor posicionamento dos equipamentos (pontos quentes) para maximizar visibilidade e giro. Omnicanalidade do Pedido: orientar e influenciar o cliente a comprar via digital, quando aplicável, aumentando frequência e recorrência de pedidos. Suporte Técnico: abrir e acompanhar chamados técnicos quando necessário em caso de quebra de equipamento, registrando aprovações/laudos conforme processo vigente. Ativação & Desativação: negociar recolha/desativação de equipamentos, conforme diretrizes comerciais. Prospecção: prospectar novos clientes na área de atuação, visando preenchimento e expansão de cobertura da rota.    Qualificações Ensino médio completo Desejável superior (incompleto) em andamento. Vivência com vendas e execução de rotina comercial. Facilidade com tecnologia (celular, apps de pedido, sistemas de vendas, excel básico, entre outros). CNH B ativa e disponibilidade para deslocamentos diários na rota.    Por que se juntar a nós?    Aqui está o que define o sucesso em nossa organização:     Somos totalmente focados em crescimento. Atuamos com velocidade e simplicidade. Vencemos juntos, com diversão. Somos corajosos para inovar e transformar nossa indústria. Nós nos importamos com as pessoas e nos desafiamos constantemente. Somos especialistas no negócio de sorvetes.  Este é um lugar para pessoas apaixonadas por sorvete e que buscam crescimento — tanto para o negócio quanto para si mesmas. Pessoas que agem como donas do negócio e conduzem tudo de ponta a ponta. Pessoas motivadas pelo sucesso, que entregam mais do que jamais imaginamos ser possível!      Você se encaixará aqui se valorizar uma cultura inclusiva e estiver entusiasmado(a) em aprender continuamente e desafiar a forma como trabalhamos, utilizando recursos digitais, dados e novas ideias para nos impulsionar cada vez mais.      Oferecemos Cargos com verdadeira responsabilidade e impacto visível. Liberdade para agir com rapidez, experimentar e desafiar a forma como as coisas são feitas. Aprendizado e desenvolvimento contínuos, à medida que o negócio cresce. Reconhecimento e recompensa alinhados ao desempenho e à contribuição de cada pessoa.    VOCÊ ESTÁ PRONTO(A) PARA CONSTRUIR O FUTURO DOS SORVETES?    Inscreva-se online e não se esqueça de enviar seu currículo. Sua candidatura será analisada de acordo com os requisitos da vaga, e entraremos em contato após o encerramento do processo para informar o status da sua inscrição.      Se você é uma pessoa com deficiência e precisar de apoio em qualquer etapa do nosso processo de recrutamento, entre em contato com o seu Talent Acquisition Partner.      Empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades      A The Magnum Ice Cream Company é uma empresa comprometida com a igualdade de oportunidades. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para contratação independentemente de raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, origem nacional ou qualquer outra condição protegida pela legislação aplicável. Não toleramos qualquer forma de discriminação, inclusive com base em deficiência.

vagas.title: Corporate travel agent
vagas.description:
Confira a vaga para Corporate travel agent em piracicaba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Job Description: Senior Corporate Account Manager      Company Overview:    b Td Travel & Jets is a leading global concierge travel company with a presence in the US, Brazil, and Portugal and expanding to Spain and Mexico in 2025 and across Europe, Latin America, and GCC later. b Td operates under three innovative models:  B2 C (exclusive membership services),  B2 B (corporate travel management), and  B2 B2 C (travel concierge services for business partners). Within the B2 B model, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge corporate travel management solutions through our  b Td Corp Tool .    This platform seamlessly blends intuitive technology with personalized services, simplifying business travel with exclusive rates on commercial flights, hotels, car services worldwide, with automated processes, and a focus on exceptional customer satisfaction. Beyond corporate travel, we also provide employees with access to  b Td travel benefits and personalized concierge services for their leisure trips, enriching their overall travel experiences.      CX Travel Specialist (2 positions: Either Early Morning Shift - From 4 AM to 13 PM Brazil time or From 4 PM to 1 AM Brazil time)    We are looking for two (2)  CX Travel Specialist to join our Customer Experience (CX) team. The ideal candidates are experienced with Amadeus and corporate travel management to support our global clients during night shifts.      Main Responsibilities   • Manage bookings for flights, hotels, and car rentals via Amadeus and other tools.   • Handle client requests, changes, and special services via Whats App and email.   • Process exchanges, refunds, EMDs, and monitor itineraries proactively.   • Support VIP and C-level travelers with high-touch, discreet service.   • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accuracy and client satisfaction.      Requirements   • Experience in luxury or corporate travel.   • Strong experience with Amadeus GDS (Air module) - Advanced level   (An Amadeus Test will be conducted to verify level of proficiency before any job offer is sent)   • Background in TMCs, agencies, or airlines.   • Proficiency in English and Portuguese. Spanish is a plus.   • Tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and flexible for night/weekend shifts.   Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across multiple languages. Intermediate knowledge in NDC platforms is required. Effective training and delegation skills, with a \"learning by doing\" approach. Ability to navigate diverse geographic markets and cultural contexts effectively. • Knowledge of ARC (USA) and or IATA BSP accounting process is a plus      Why Join Us   • Work in a dynamic, global environment focused on service excellence.   • Engage with high-profile clients and premium travel partners.   • Be part of a collaborative, growth-oriented culture.   • Enjoy a remote-first setup with flexible work arrangements      b Td Travel Culture:    At b Td, we are passionate about travel, bridging distances, connecting worlds, and creating unique experiences for our clients. We foster a culture that embodies entrepreneurship, hands-on collaboration, and teamwork. Our flexible work environment supports work-life balance, eliminating commuting time and offering opportunities for relocation or nomadic work. We are driven by a global mindset, a passion for client success, and a strong focus on results. Our environment values risk-taking, leadership development, and learning by doing, providing multiple opportunities for personal and professional growth. We respect diversity at all levels and embrace meritocracy, rewarding high performance and ensuring no space for toxic behavior or poor performance.    b Td is committed to corporate governance, ethics, and mutual trust, building confidence through facts and evidence rather than perceptions. We promote an open, friendly, and respectful atmosphere where differences and preferences are honored. Join us and grow alongside b Td, with the opportunity to become part of the company’s evolution and stakes.      Terms of Employment: Employment under  CLT (Brazilian Labor Laws) . Remote work arrangement, with a 44-hour workweek Flexibility to travel domestically within Brazil and internationally to locations where b Td operates. This position is required or night shift and weekends, with flexibility. Excels in remote work for a global hybrid startup, combining tech-driven travel solutions with personalized services.    Compensation: Competitive base salary. Night shift extra hours Performance-based bonuses and monthly premiums based on achieving KPIs. Sales commissions for achieving and exceeding targets. Health and dental insurance. Food card. Birthday day off. Opportunity for professional growth, with the potential to be promoted to  Head of Corporate Globally as b Td evolves through its funding rounds. Access to travel-related perks and benefits as part of the b Td team.    Important Note Before Applying:    Let’s keep it real! Apply only if you meet at least 80% of the qualifications and can prove it with your  Linked In profile or  updated resume . We’re not looking for someone who just \"gets it\" — we need a  self-starter ready to deliver results from  day one .    Forget gaming Linked In algorithms; we care about real achievements. If your experience matches the role and your profile shows your impact, we’re excited to hear from you, hire you fast, reward your contributions, and grow together.    Note: Only candidates meeting the criteria will be contacted for an interview. Let’s keep it efficient and worthwhile for everyone!      b Td Travel – Where Business Meets Innovation.

vagas.title: Product analyst - vmake · brazil
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Product analyst - vmake · brazil em chapecó. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Why We Need You    We’re building an AI-powered video creation platform that empowers creators, brands, and e-commerce sellers to produce high-performing content with ease. As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.      You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.      What You’ll Do Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience. Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements. Monitor trends across Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, You Tube Shorts, Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations. Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning. Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps. Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations. Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration. Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch. Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.    Who You Are 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within Saa S, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology. Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms. Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies. Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data. Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.    Preferred Qualifications Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence. Experience with Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms. Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery. Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma. Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work. Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.      About the Role:    We’re currently working on expanding our Central Data Team to increase our product portfolio with members who build, create and maintain our data products. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply.    The Data Specialist plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .    Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Specialist works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.    See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current Data Specialists love working here!      As Our Data Specialist, you will: Take ownership of high-impact work with guidance — whether that’s running or building data products end-to-end, supporting centralized data ingestion pipelines the broader team relies on, or building clean, granular data feeds that help clients dive into data. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies we cover and datasets we analyze. You’ll learn our proprietary methods and techniques, building the judgment and mental models to understand why our data works — not just how to produce it. Use AI and tooling to accelerate your learning and work — assisting with queries, investigations, debugging, and repetitive tasks. You’ll develop the habit of validating AI-generated outputs rather than assuming correctness, building a foundation for using AI effectively throughout your career here. Become a trusted resource for internal stakeholders and clients , working with them to identify and answer key questions. You’ll contribute to data feeds, custom analyses, and reports consumed by the top investors in the world. Improve the products, pipelines, and data feeds you own — we value curiosity and experimentation, and we expect you to follow established best practices while also questioning the status quo and identifying opportunities for improvement. Learn or sharpen SQL, Python, and Py Spark skills starting with our two-month new hire training program covering technical fundamentals as well as our internal tools and processes. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. vagas.title: Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno
vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Designer de conteúdo com ia pleno em arapongas. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a Payfy  A Payfy é uma fintech B2 B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte.    Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.     Sobre a vaga:  Designer de Conteúdo com IA é quem projeta, produz e publica o conteúdo da nossa plataforma de transformação com IA para times financeiros — do começo ao fim.    Projetar vem primeiro, e é o que define a função: pensar a pauta antes de executá-la, decidir se ela vira carrossel ou vídeo, onde ela entra no calendário e o que precisa dizer. Depois vem a execução — desenhar a peça, editar o vídeo, escrever a copy e colocar no ar. Tudo com a mesma pessoa, do início ao fim.      É uma posição nova no mercado e já é realidade aqui: a Payfy tem profissionais no time atuando exatamente assim.      O que torna esse escopo possível é a forma como a gente trabalha. Ferramentas de IA generativa (Claude/Claude Design, entre outras) estão na rotina diária e absorvem a parte mecânica da execução — variações de peça, primeiro corte, versões de copy, adaptação de formato. Some a isso um acervo de vídeo já montado (padrões de título, vinheta, GC, mockups, backgrounds animados) e um sistema visual definido: você quase nunca começa do zero.      Por isso o perfil é generalista: repertório em design, vídeo e social media, e critério para decidir o que publicar, em que ordem e com que cara. É aí que seu tempo vai — o trabalho braçal fica com a IA.    Você vai ter autonomia real sobre a operação e apoio direto de quem já construiu todo o padrão visual e narrativo da marca.      O que você vai fazer:    Calendário e planejamento   Montar o calendário editorial mensal Traduzir temas, lançamentos e novidades da plataforma em pautas de conteúdo Manter a régua de publicação rodando de forma previsível, sem depender de demanda chegar  Produção visual   Criar carrosséis, posts estáticos, stories e peças para mídia paga dentro da identidade da marca Produzir capas de conteúdo para a plataforma (cursos, aulas, eventos) Manter rigor estético e consistência de marca em tudo que sai  Vídeo   Editar as videoaulas e conteúdos diversos a partir de um acervo de assets já prontos Realizar cortes, encaixes, montagem e exportação Apoiar novas gravações quando entrarem no calendário  Publicação e acompanhamento   Agendar e publicar via MLabs e canais próprios Conferir se a postagem subiu, se ficou correta, se precisa de ajuste Contribuir com ideias para materiais ricos (e-books, planilhas, ferramentas usadas como isca)    O que a gente espera de você:    Requisitos   Experiência prévia montando calendários de social media (não apenas executando peças) Experiência prévia editando vídeo — domínio dos princípios de enquadramento, ritmo e montagem Boas noções de design: hierarquia, contraste, uso de cor, composição. Você não precisa desenhar do zero, mas precisa saber enxergar quando algo está errado Boa escrita: headlines, copy de post, roteiro Disciplina para trabalho remoto — organização própria, cumprimento de prazos, comunicação ativa Disposição real para aprender ferramentas de IA e mudar a forma de trabalhar    O perfil que a gente procura   Visão macro de projetos Autonomia: pegar uma pauta e levá-la até a publicação, sem precisar de briefing mastigado a cada passo Organização e consistência Senso de dono    Diferenciais   Experiência com Adobe Premiere, After Effects, Cap Cut Familiaridade com Figma, Notion, MLabs Já ter usado ferramentas de IA generativa para produção de conteúdo Conhecimento de boas práticas de You Tube (SEO de descrição, configuração de publicação, leitura de retenção) Repertório em finanças/B2 B    Como é trabalhar aqui:   Remoto de verdade, com rituais definidos: alinhamento semanal com o time e encontros de acompanhamento com o gestor direto ao longo da semana Aprendizado estruturado, você vai lapidar seus conhecimentos em: MLabs, boas práticas de IA aplicada a conteúdo, padrão de edição dos vídeos, produto e marca Espaço para crescer    Processo seletivo:   Inscrição e triagem de currículo — RH Envio de portfólio — 3 peças autorais, sendo obrigatoriamente uma delas um vídeo editado por você Teste perfil comportamental (DISC) — RH Desafio prático — um projeto integrado e realista: uma peça de design, um carrossel, um vídeo curto e a copy/headline que amarra tudo, a partir de um tema que a gente entrega. O que a gente avalia aqui é sobretudo o raciocínio: como você estruturou o conjunto, não só o acabamento de cada peça Entrevista técnica — com o gestor direto, junto com a devolutiva do desafio Entrevista de liderança — com a liderança de Marketing    O que oferecemos   Contrato CLT — R$ 4.000,00 Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses) Day off de aniversário Wellhub + Conexa Saúde Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia    Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy    Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade.      Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.    Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's commercial and procurement legal work in Brazil: master services agreements, supply and distribution agreements, framework agreements, partnership and reseller contracts, and public procurement matters. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies — on both the buy side and the sell side. Advise clients on public procurement: tender preparation and review, bid compliance, framework agreements, contract award procedures, and challenge / remedies processes. Draft and negotiate SLAs, pricing and payment schedules, liability and indemnity frameworks, warranties, and termination provisions. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising commercial or procurement law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with commercial contracting — services, supply, distribution, licensing, liability, indemnities, and termination. Public procurement grounding. Experience with public tender processes and procurement regulation (EU procurement directives or local equivalents), ideally from both the bidder and contracting-authority perspective. Strong negotiation instincts. You know which points move the deal and which are noise. Commercial fluency. You can read a pricing model, understand the business behind the contract, and ask the right questions. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work at the sharp end of high-volume commercial contracting — with AI tooling that removes the drudgery, not the judgment. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para International bookkeeper & finance specialist (remote - brazil) em jaraguá do sul. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title: International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist (Remote - Brazil)    Position Type: Full-Time or Part-Time Contract    Location: Remote (Must be based in Brazil)    Reports To: CRO / Founder    Language Requirement: Bilingual (Fluent English and Portuguese)      We are a growing digital business with an established US LLC and a expanding presence in Brazil (including a physical office in São Paulo and a localized sales team). We are seeking a highly skilled International Bookkeeper & Finance Specialist to manage the day-to-day accounting, billing, and operational cash flow for both entities. In this dual-entity role, you will be the bridge between our US financial ecosystem and our local Brazilian operations. You will ensure that invoices are processed globally, local Brazilian expenses and payroll are tracked perfectly, and the books for both entities remain entirely compliant, clean, and organized.    Key Responsibilities:   1. Dual-Entity Bookkeeping & Reconciliations: Maintain accurate, up-to-date ledgers for both the US LLC and the Brazilian entity using cloud accounting software (e.g., Quick Books Online and local Brazilian platforms like Agilize). Perform routine bank, credit card, and multi-currency payment gateway reconciliations. Track intercompany transactions (capital injections, service fees, or expense allocations between the US entity and the Brazil office). 2. Global Billing & Accounts Receivable (AR): Generate and dispatch accurate monthly invoices to international agency clients and programmatic partners. Manage accounts receivable for local Brazilian clients, issuing standard local invoices (Nota Fiscal de Serviço - NFS-e) where applicable. Proactively monitor outstanding balances and handle professional collections via email/phone in both English and Portuguese. 3. Accounts Payable (AP) & Local Disbursements: Process payments for US and international tech vendors, platforms, and contractors. Manage local accounts payable in Brazil, including office expenses (São Paulo), local supplier invoices, and employee expense reports. Coordinate with our local Brazilian HR/payroll agency to ensure the local sales team is paid accurately and on time according to local labor laws (CLT/PJ structure). 4. Data Integrity & Reporting: Properly categorize all transactions according to US tax guidelines for the LLC, and Brazilian accounting standards (BR GAAP/RFB requirements) for the local entity. Compile monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheets for both entities, providing a consolidated view of cash flow to ownership.  Required Qualifications & Skills: Cross-Border Experience (Mandatory): 3+ years of direct experience handling finances for a company that operates across both the US and Brazil. You must understand how US business accounting works and be familiar with standard Brazilian corporate financial practices. Language Fluency: Flawless written and spoken English (for US vendors/clients) and Portuguese (for local operations, banks, and agencies). Technical Proficiency: Deep experience with global cloud accounting tools (Quick Books, Xero) and strong advanced skills in Excel/Google Sheets. Localization Knowledge: Familiarity with Brazilian financial concepts like Notas Fiscais, basic withholding taxes, and foreign exchange (FX) remittance processes between US and Brazilian banks.  What We Offer: 100% remote working environment with flexibility. Direct involvement in an exciting, multi-market international expansion.

Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)     $1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses      We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1 M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.      Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, You Tube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.      What You'll Actually Do      High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.      Master Direct Response Mechanics:   Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches) Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, You Tube Shorts) A/B test visual approaches based on performance data    Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or Da Vinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.      Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.      AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.      Top Fits Will Have: Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement) 2+ years editing for DTC/e Commerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal) Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners) Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or Da Vinci Resolve + After Effects Deep understanding of Meta/You Tube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)    Bonus Points: Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes) Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4 D) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles Familiarity with Cap Cut, Descript, or AI editing tools Portuguese + English fluency    Non-Negotiables: Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions) Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment Obsessive attention to detail Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback      Why Top Editors Choose Us:      Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.      Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.      See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).     ️ Professional Setup Access to premium stock libraries, SFX collections, motion graphics templates, and AI tools. We invest in your efficiency.      Fully Remote + Flexible Work from anywhere with reliable internet. Core overlap hours with US Eastern Time for collaboration.      High-Volume Learning Produce more ads in 6 months than most editors create in 2 years. Accelerate your skills exponentially.      Application Process:      Step 1: Submit Application Current CV/resume Portfolio link with 3-5 best DTC ads (Vimeo, Google Drive, or You Tube unlisted) Brief note (3-4 sentences) explaining which ad in your portfolio performed best and why you think it worked    Step 2: Paid Test Project ($100 USD) Top candidates receive raw footage + a creative brief to produce a 30-60 second Meta ad. Turnaround: 48 hours.      Step 3: Interview + Strategy Discussion 30-minute video call to discuss your creative process, workflow, and alignment with our brand.      Step 4: Onboarding Start with a 2-week paid trial producing live ads for our campaigns.      Applications without portfolio samples will be not be considered.      Good luck! We are excited to meet you!

vagas.description:
Nova oportunidade para Remote investment lawyer - brazil em araraquara. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's venture and investment work in Brazil: seed and growth equity rounds, SAFEs and convertible instruments, term sheets, shareholder agreements, and secondaries. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of investment documentation for founders, startups, angels, and funds — on both the company side and the investor side. Run legal due diligence, manage closing processes and conditions precedent, and coordinate signing and completion. Advise on cap table structuring, employee option plans (ESOPs), governance and board matters, and investor rights. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising venture capital, private equity, or corporate finance law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with investment documentation — term sheets, subscription and shareholders' agreements, SAFEs and convertible notes, and articles / constitutional documents. Both-sides experience. You've acted for companies and for investors, and you know where each side's real risk sits. Fluency in startup economics. Liquidation preferences, anti-dilution, vesting, option pools — and how they interact across rounds. Speed with precision. Venture deals move fast; your documents still close cleanly. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Work with ambitious founders and funds on deals that move fast — supported by tooling that keeps pace. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

About Moritz      Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.      We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.      We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.      Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.      The Role     Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's M& A work in Brazil: share and asset deals, mergers, carve-outs, and joint ventures for clients ranging from startups to midsize companies. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of SPAs and APAs, disclosure schedules, warranties and indemnities, and ancillary transaction documents. Run legal due diligence, coordinate specialist workstreams (tax, employment, IP, regulatory), and manage the transaction timeline through signing and closing. Advise on deal structuring, earn-outs and deferred consideration, W& I insurance, closing mechanics, and post-closing matters. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.    What You'll Bring     5+ years practising M& A or corporate law in private practice or in-house. End-to-end deal experience. You've led transactions from term sheet through closing, not just supported workstreams. Deep familiarity with transaction documents — SPAs, APAs, disclosure letters, warranty and indemnity regimes, and completion mechanics. Due diligence command. You can scope, run, and synthesize a diligence exercise into findings a buyer can act on. Cross-border fluency. Comfortable coordinating with counsel in other jurisdictions on multi-country deals. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.    Why Moritz     Run deals with modern tooling — faster diligence, cleaner documents, and clients who value speed and certainty. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.    Frequently Asked Questions      How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?      Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.      What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?      Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.      Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?      No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.      How are co-counsel matched to client matters?      Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms

Buscamos um(a) profissional com sólida experiência em pós-vendas para atuar com desenvolvimento de conteúdos e ministrar treinamentos sobre peças automotivas, sistemas, processos e operações de Pós-Vendas, garantindo profundidade técnica, aplicação prática e impacto no desenvolvimento da rede de concessionárias.      Principais Responsabilidades Desenvolver conteúdos técnicos, comerciais e comportamentais para programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento. Ministrar treinamentos presenciais e virtuais para equipes operacionais, comerciais e lideranças da rede de concessionárias. Traduzir conceitos técnicos e estratégicos em conteúdos claros, aplicáveis e alinhados à realidade do negócio. Desenvolver treinamentos voltados para processos de pós-vendas, peças, serviços, atendimento ao cliente, vendas e rentabilidade. Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências de liderança, gestão de equipes e melhoria de resultados. Acompanhar tendências, processos e melhores práticas do mercado automotivo, garantindo a atualização contínua dos conteúdos de treinamento. Contribuir para a evolução dos programas de aprendizagem, promovendo engajamento, qualidade e impacto nos resultados do negócio. Atuar como parceiro consultivo junto às áreas de negócio, identificando necessidades de treinamento, oportunidades de desenvolvimento e iniciativas de melhoria de performance. Desenvolver conteúdos alinhados às necessidades específicas da rede de concessionárias, garantindo aplicabilidade prática às rotinas e desafios da operação de pós-vendas. Incorporar conceitos e boas práticas de atendimento ao cliente nos programas de treinamento, com foco em relacionamento, experiência do cliente e excelência na prestação de serviços. Facilitar workshops, dinâmicas e discussões estruturadas que promovam reflexão, troca de experiências, desenvolvimento de lideranças e fortalecimento das competências de gestão. Demonstrar profundo entendimento da área de Peças, utilizando linguagem adequada ao público-alvo e abordando desafios, oportunidades e melhores práticas do segmento. Conectar conhecimentos técnicos, processos, pessoas e estratégias de negócio, proporcionando uma experiência de aprendizagem relevante e alinhada aos objetivos da rede de concessionárias.    Requisitos Graduação completa. Sólido conhecimento técnico em peças automotivas, sistemas e processos de pós-vendas. Experiência em concessionárias automotivas, especialmente nas áreas de Peças, Oficina, Serviços e Atendimento ao Cliente. Conhecimento dos processos de compras e vendas de peças, varejo e atacado. Vivência na condução de treinamentos e desenvolvimento de conteúdo para equipes operacionais e lideranças. Habilidade para facilitar treinamentos e promover aprendizagem de forma prática e engajadora. Capacidade de conectar aspectos técnicos, comerciais e comportamentais para gerar impacto no desempenho das equipes. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita. Disponibilidade para viagens.    Diferenciais Experiência com treinamento corporativo no segmento automotivo. Vivência em programas de desenvolvimento de lideranças. Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem Experiência na utilização de plataformas de aprendizagem e ferramentas digitais de treinamento.    Competências Comportamentais Comunicação e influência. Facilidade para relacionamento interpessoal. Protagonismo e senso de dono. Capacidade de engajar diferentes públicos. Pensamento analítico e visão de negócio. Colaboração e trabalho em equipe. Adaptabilidade e flexibilidade. Mentalidade de crescimento (Growth Mindset).    Perfil Desejado    Profissional apaixonado por desenvolvimento de pessoas, com forte conhecimento técnico, comercial e visão de negócio, capaz de atuar como facilitador, consultor e instrutor. Deve ser uma pessoa que compreenda profundamente a realidade das concessionárias e consiga transformar desafios operacionais e comerciais em oportunidades de aprendizagem, contribuindo para o crescimento das equipes, a excelência operacional e os resultados da rede de pós-vendas.

Position Details    Job Title: Antenna Sales Manager    Department: Sales — Latin America    Reports To: Regional Sales Director, LATAM    Location: Brazil or Mexico — supporting the LATAM region    Work Arrangement: Hybrid / Remote (home-office based, customer-facing)    Employment Type: Full-Time    Travel Required: Up to (40–50)% across the LATAM territory      Role Objective    Maximize Quectel’s LATAM market share and revenue for antenna products by developing new customers and verticals, accelerating antenna design wins, and enabling Regional Sales Managers to expand antenna penetration within the existing customer base.      Primary Responsibilities    Market Growth & New Business Own LATAM growth for Quectel antenna products and solutions, with a strong focus on new customer acquisition, new verticals, and share expansion. Build and actively hunt a prioritized funnel of target accounts with clear next actions, opportunity value, and design-win potential. Identify cross-sell opportunities within the existing Quectel customer base and partner with RSMs to position antennas alongside modules and connectivity solutions. Develop account strategies for OEMs, ODMs, and EMS providers whose products require cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, or combination antennas.  Customer & Design-Win Development Understand customer applications, RF/connectivity requirements, and program timing, and coordinate the right antenna solution. Track antenna evaluations, samples, technical discussions, qualifications, and design-in/design-win progress through the regional funnel. Initiate and schedule customer roadmap meetings to identify future programs and influence antenna selection early in the design cycle. Maintain strong follow-up with prospects and customers from initial opportunity through technical evaluation and commercial conversion.  Sales Enablement & Channel Development Train Regional Sales Managers, representative firms, and distributors on Quectel antenna positioning, target applications, and sales messages. Create account-specific selling strategies and support local teams in advancing antenna opportunities. Provide competitive and market insights that help the wider sales organization win antenna business.  Product & Internal Collaboration Work closely with Product Management and technical teams on customer requirements, product fit, competitive gaps, and future roadmap needs. Translate market feedback into actionable input for product planning and commercial strategy. Coordinate internal resources to move strategic opportunities through evaluation and decision stages.  CRM, Reporting & Market Intelligence Maintain accurate and current account, opportunity, and activity information in Salesforce CRM. Prepare a monthly LATAM business review covering pipeline, leads, technical evaluations, meetings, risks, and next steps. Monitor market trends, competitors, target verticals, and major customer programs relevant to antenna growth in LATAM. Attend trade shows and industry events to identify target accounts and capture qualified contacts for follow-up.    Qualifications & Experience    What we are looking for (5)+ years of demonstrated success in B2 B technical sales, business development, or segment sales within antennas, RF components, wireless connectivity, Io T hardware, or a closely related field. Strong ability to prospect, build pipeline, develop new accounts, and drive opportunities toward design wins and revenue. Working understanding of customer design cycles and what it takes to win embedded hardware business. Comfort discussing antenna use cases across cellular, GNSS, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth, and connected-device applications. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills across a multi-country sales region. Hands-on CRM discipline and clear funnel and business-review reporting. Fluent Portuguese and/or Spanish, plus professional working English. Willingness to travel across LATAM for customer meetings, partner development, and industry events.  Preferred background Experience selling antennas, RF solutions, Io T modules, or related components to OEM/ODM/EMS customers. Existing relationships within LATAM Io T, industrial, telematics, or tracking ecosystems. Experience supporting distributors, representative firms, or channel partners. Ability to collaborate with Product Management, FAE, and engineering teams on technical evaluations. Familiarity with certification and homologation processes in LATAM markets (e.g., ANATEL, IFT).  What Success Looks Like Growth in qualified antenna pipeline and new target accounts. Increase in antenna design-ins/design wins and commercial conversions. Higher antenna penetration across existing Quectel accounts. Strong RSM/channel enablement and opportunity follow-through. Accurate Salesforce funnel management and monthly reporting. Actionable market/competitive intelligence that improves sales execution.    About Quectel    Quectel’s passion for a smarter world drives us to accelerate Io T innovation. We are an end-to-end global Io T solutions provider, and our team of more than 5,800 professionals delivers cellular, GNSS, satellite, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth modules, high-performance antennas, and full turnkey offerings including ODM services and system integration.    Founded in 2010 and headquartered in Shanghai, Quectel operates offices, R&D centers, and support teams across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM. Our antenna business combines a broad standard portfolio with full custom design support — simulation, testing, tuning, and manufacturing.      Industries & Applications    Quectel’s modules and antennas power innovation across:   Smart metering and utilities Asset tracking, telematics, and logistics Smart agriculture Smart cities and infrastructure Industrial Io T and automation Connected mobility and automotive Smart home and consumer Io T  Why Quectel LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Own a product line across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth — Mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths. Cutting-Edge Technology — Next-generation 5 G, GNSS, NTN/satellite, and custom antenna solutions in mission-critical applications. Inclusive, Global Team — A multicultural workplace collaborating with Io T experts across engineering, sales, and operations.  Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary benchmarked to the local market in Brazil or Mexico Uncapped sales commission tied to antenna revenue and design wins in your territory Meal and grocery vouchers Private health insurance with no co-pay, extendable to dependents Dental coverage Life insurance and accident cover Paid time off plus statutory holidays, and paid parental leave per local law International exposure — HQ visits and global trade shows such as CES, Embedded World, and MWC Structured onboarding and ongoing product training, with internal mobility across a global organization    Learn More    Explore products, careers, and news at or follow Quectel Wireless Solutions on Linked In.    Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on business priorities and market needs.      Quectel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristic.
